about: The W over P rows of the pico ABI performance matrix measured on Windows x64 (docs/pico-perf-matrix.md section 6): arm W the library of the Windows package, arm P zenoh-pico built with MSVC as the same build, run by scripts/host-bench/windows/perf_matrix.ps1 and judged by `scripts/host-bench/perf_matrix.py --gate` on the reading it writes. The rows, their four shapes and the rule are those of deploy/pico_perf_ceiling.json; `platform` keeps the two apart, so a run is judged only against the rows of the platform it was made on, `stdlib` (`nostd`, the package a release ships) against the rows of the library it measured, and `preset` against the rows of a package built as zenoh-pico's preset in wz (configs/zenoh-pico_defconfig), which `windows-plan` states of each package. A row is written only from the gate's own output for a run, never by hand.
